crossRefs.note: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

translations.web: Be diligent to come to me soon,
translations.bsb: Make every effort to come to me quickly,
translations.kjv: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
translations.asv: Give diligence to come shortly unto me:
